candidates.title: The Waterwheel That Skipped Every Seventh Turn
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a village waterwheel jolted after every seventh rotation before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they lubricated the axle but the jolt returned at the same interval; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a damaged gear tooth engaged only after the smaller gear completed seven turns; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they replaced the damaged gear and measured a smooth rotation cycle, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Garden That Flooded Without Rain
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a rooftop garden flooded each morning despite clear skies before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they reduced watering but the puddles grew; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized condensation from an air-conditioning drain flowed beneath the planting beds; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they rerouted the drain and restored the soil's safe moisture level, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Beacon That Answered Itself
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the harbor watch received a reply to its distress signal from an empty island before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the radio antenna but the reply persisted; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a repeater left in test mode was rebroadcasting the original signal after a delay; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they reset the repeater and verified messages with the island station, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
